newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India drift after Bombay profits taken.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India drift after Bombay profits taken.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts finished quietly firmer on Thursday after stocks in Bombay succumbed to late profit taking amid few fresh factors, traders said.
They said GDRs had taken a breather after strong gains on Wednesday, and the market could stay flat on Friday.
But the longer-term trend was positive, they said.
Reliance ended off its highs, gaining 10 cents on the day to $22.65/23.65, while Bajaj shed 60 cents to $34.00/35.50. SBI was 17 cents firmer at $27.00/28.00.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.19 points firmer at 89.18, a 0.21 percent rise, with the premium over the local market at 20.29 percent from 19.89 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index shed 26.32 points to 4,378.37 following Wednesday's 98.30 point gain.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index was mildly softer after the local market eased. The index shed 0.14 points to 76.19 points, a premium of 40.32 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 1.89 points higher at 133.93, representing a discount to the local market of 1.62 percent.
